title: MoS2 Contact Resistance Model Limitations, Validity Envelopes, and Dataset Gaps

major_literature_biases: Severe n-type bias: >95% of published 2D MoS2 studies investigate electron injection; p-type contacts remain severely under-characterized.
Room-temperature bias: 90% of extracted Rc values are reported at 300 K; temperature-dependent activation curves (4 K - 300 K) are sparse.
Contact geometry bias: Overwhelming focus on top-contact geometries; 1D edge contacts (e.g., via etched h-BN/graphene trenches) are rarely tabulated.
Publication bias toward low Rc: Studies achieving poor contact (> 1e5 Ohm*um) frequently omit TLM de-embedding, skewing literature toward best-case devices.

gate_carrier_density.lower_bound_failure_mode: Subthreshold regime where current is dominated by channel thermionic barrier rather than contact resistance.
gate_carrier_density.upper_bound_failure_mode: Dielectric breakdown (Fowler-Nordheim leakage and oxide rupture) in thin high-k gate stacks.

schottky_barrier_height.lower_bound_failure_mode: Ohmic degenerate state bounded strictly by the Landauer-Sharvin quantum ballistic limit (~ 18-36 Ohm*um).
schottky_barrier_height.upper_bound_failure_mode: Complete carrier freeze-out where current drops below noise floor (Rc > 1e7 Ohm*um).

thermal_budget_limits.bismuth_semimetal: T_process < 240 deg C (Bismuth dewetting and balling threshold).
thermal_budget_limits.1T_phase_mos2: T_process < 100 deg C (Metastable 1T to 2H relaxation threshold).
thermal_budget_limits.reactive_metals_ti_sc: T_process < 400 deg C (Excessive metal-sulfur interdiffusion leading to MoS2 lattice destruction).

transfer_length_effect.current_crowding_envelope: Model assumes contact length L_c > 2 * L_T (~ 50-100 nm). For sub-30nm scaled contact lengths, 2D edge current crowding increases effective Rc.

future_experimental_priorities.title: Systematic P-Type Contact Benchmark on 2D MoS2
future_experimental_priorities.rationale: Complementary CMOS logic strictly requires high-performance p-FETs. Experimental validation with high work-function metals (Pt, Pd, Au) under high-k hole accumulation is essential.
future_experimental_priorities.target_measurement: TLM de-embedded Rc and Richardson activation SBH under hole accumulation (Vgs < -2 V with thin HfO2).

future_experimental_priorities.title: Cryogenic Temperature-Dependent TLM (4 K - 300 K)
future_experimental_priorities.rationale: Decouple tunneling vs thermionic emission across the full temperature range. Freeze-out measurements will verify if zero-barrier Bi contacts remain Ohmic at 4 K.
future_experimental_priorities.target_measurement: Four-probe TLM contact resistance vs 1000/T to extract true zero-bias barrier height.

future_experimental_priorities.title: Contact Scaling Down to Sub-20 nm Contact Length (Lc)
future_experimental_priorities.rationale: IRDS roadmap requires physical contact pitch < 40 nm. Characterize current crowding and transfer length scaling limits at ultra-scaled dimensions.
future_experimental_priorities.target_measurement: Rc vs Lc scaling from 10 nm to 500 nm to measure transmission length LT.

future_experimental_priorities.title: Standardized Extraction Protocol Benchmark (TLM vs Y-Function)
future_experimental_priorities.rationale: Eliminate inter-lab extraction variance by conducting cross-methodology comparisons on the same identical physical device.
future_experimental_priorities.target_measurement: Simultaneous TLM, Y-function, and gated four-probe extraction on identical lithographic patterns.

future_experimental_priorities.title: Air-Stability and Accelerated Lifetime Aging Analysis
future_experimental_priorities.rationale: Semimetal and 1T contacts degrade rapidly in ambient humidity. Quantify degradation kinetics and capping layer (ALD Al2O3, h-BN) effectiveness over 1000+ hours.
future_experimental_priorities.target_measurement: Time-dependent Rc drift under 85 deg C / 85% relative humidity stress testing.
